subject: crm-cleanup
title: Three records for one customer: a sample CRM duplicate review
description:
A walk through a sample CRM data cleanup review sheet for an invented cleaning company, for small sales teams: duplicate groups with a suggested record to keep, and data-quality issues.

CRM Duplicate and Data-Quality Check: a pilot offer from Amber One. The sample uses an invented business and invented data. A person reviews every report before it goes to you. Narrated with a synthetic voice.

#crm #datacleanup

See the sample report and the pilot terms: https://hq.amberoneai.com/offers/crm-cleanup?src=youtube&utm_campaign=crm-cleanup-sample-walkthrough
narration: Same customer, three records, three different owners. Sound familiar?
In this sample, forty contacts held seven duplicate groups. Each group says how sure the match is, and why.
Each group gets a suggested record to keep, and conflicts, like different owners, are flagged for a person to decide.
You get a proposed-changes sheet to review and apply yourself. Nothing is merged or deleted by Amber.
